selection_rule: All physical sample names in original preflight matrix with exactly one exact case-insensitive Spectrum Name match in official chemistry table. No selection by intensity or predictions.
grouping: Physical sample name, all replicate columns; entire campaign external-only. Dates not recovered in compiled product; conservatively one session.

preprocessing.gaps: Unobserved features removed from estimator input and templates; no interpolation across spectrometer gaps

labels.positive: reported finite oxide wt% > 0 for Na2O MgO CaO FeOT
labels.unknown: missing, zero, negative values; H and He always unknown
labels.negative: none: rounded zero is not proof of elemental absence
labels.chemistry_is_not_spectral_prediction: Official calibration-standard reference composition table; no Mars MOC prediction tables used.

metrics.primary: equal-physical-sample weighted recall on known positive labels; per-element support, misses and recall
metrics.uncertainty: sample-cluster percentile bootstrap, 1000 resamples seed20261013; conditional on this acquisition campaign
metrics.replicate_vote: mean binary detection within each physical sample; no replicate treated as independent sample

synthetic_development.mechanism: linear combinations of pixel-integrated Gaussian NIST templates; Gaussian noise; identical observation mask applied to templates/train/development/real test
synthetic_development.thresholds: select per-class F1 on synthetic development only

adaptation: none: no real-spectrum alignment, scaling fit, model/calibration/threshold selection; profile fixed from instrument documentation before predictions
